senses.gloss:
रट् रट्, cl. 1. P. रटति, रराट, &c., to
shout, howl, yell, cry, scream, roar, bellow;
to call out, proclaim aloud; to shout with joy,
applaud: Caus. रटयति, &c., to shout, &c.; to
speak [cf. rt. रठ्]: Intens. रारटीति, to scream
aloud.

रटन, अम्, n. the act of shouting, &c.; cry or
shout of applause, approbation.

रटन्ती, f., N. of the fourteenth day in the dark
half of the month Māgha.

रटित, अस्, आ, अम्, screamed, shouted, &c.; (अम्),
n. a roar, yell, scream, cry.
रट्टा रट्टा, f., N. of a princess.

राटिका, f. in मृग-र्˚, q. v., (perhaps) ‘causing
the deer to scream.’
राटु, उस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
